objectives.statement: Match sin, si, sitt, and sine to the gender and number of the owned noun.
Use sin, si, sitt, and sine when the sentence subject owns the noun.
Contrast sin, si, sitt, and sine with hans, hennes, and deres when the owner is not the subject.
Recognize that sin, si, sitt, and sine cannot stand in subject position.

notes: Must contrast subject-owned sin/si/sitt/sine with non-reflexive hans/hennes/deres; include agreement with owned noun and prohibition in subject position.
